moments.title: I'm A Celebrity...Get Me Out Of Here! 2026 Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The 26th series of I'm a Celebrity...Get Me Out of Here! began on Monday, November 16, 2026, on ITV1 and ITVX, featuring celebrities like Wayne Rooney and Joanna Page.

angles.name: Jungle Life Begins
angles.copy: The jungle gates are open! I'm A Celeb is back, and the new campmates are already facing their fears. Who are you backing to be crowned King or Queen of the Jungle? #ImACeleb

angles.name: Rooney in the Jungle
angles.copy: From the football pitch to the Bushtucker Trials! Wayne Rooney is among the stars braving the Australian jungle in the new series of I'm A Celebrity. Can he conquer the critters? #ImACeleb

angles.name: TV Must-Watch
angles.copy: Ant & Dec are back Down Under! I'm A Celebrity 2026 is officially underway, bringing us three weeks of celebrity antics and gruelling challenges. Tune in nightly on ITV1. #ImACeleb
